notablePrerequisites: Sephiroth, Planet's Heir has a +1/+1 counter on it.
description:
If needed, give Sephiroth deathtouch.
Activate Sephiroth using Walking Ballista's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to a creature an opponent controls and destroying it due to Sephiroth's deathtouch.
When the creature dies, Sephiroth triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 2.
